---
title: "Current implementation and first use"
---

Run R and Python locally with a shared workspace, console and plots. Bundled examples run offline; extra packages and imported code may use the network.

This page describes the October–November 2026 refinements. These source changes are not part of older development release downloads. Local checks are distinct from device, live-service and store acceptance.

## Build from a clean checkout

Flutter 3.47.9 / Dart 3.13.7, Python 3, JDK 17, Android SDK 36 and build-tools 35.0.0. Set JAVA_HOME and ANDROID_HOME. A device/emulator is required to install; a full Xcode installation is needed for iOS.

```sh
python3 tool/test_fetch_runtimes.py
bash tool/fetch_runtimes.sh
flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
flutter analyze
flutter test
flutter build apk --debug --target-platform android-arm64
adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk
```

These commands build from this source tree. Debug APKs are development artifacts; release bundles need private signing and device acceptance. A successful build is not a store submission.

## Use and verification

Read the [repository README](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-atelier/blob/main/README.md) for the exact application workflow, privacy/storage behavior and platform differences. The [October–November refinement record](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-atelier/blob/main/docs/refinement-2026-10.md) records findings, changes, observed checks, deferred work and the next release action. Local checks alone do not establish remote CI results.

For published source `1716676a820a`, [application CI](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-atelier/actions/runs/41200143039) passed on 2026-10-31, including host tests, the offline browser R/Python journey and Android packaging. At that milestone, Android WebView acceptance was still open; the later scoped Android results follow below. Full iOS compilation remains open.

On 2026-11-02, the final smaller APK identified in the refinement record passed an in-place Android upgrade with the saved R file and examples unchanged. Its actual offline UI executed R/Python arithmetic, pandas/SciPy/OpenBLAS/scikit-learn calculations and both bundled histogram examples on an API 35 ARM64/4 KiB emulator; the saved file reopened after restart. Physical-device/16 KiB behavior, full iOS compilation and GPL corresponding-source/distribution gates remain open.

Automatic CI APK uploads are held until the runtime source-delivery gate in [THIRD_PARTY.md](https://github.com/etabli-dev/etabli-atelier/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY.md) is closed; preparation, runtime tests and APK builds remain enabled.
